name: Läh-Hof
beschreibung: The Läh-Hof welcomes guests to the picturesque alpine village of Nesselwängle in Tyrol's renowned Tannheim Valley. Framed by the dramatic limestone peaks of the Rote Flüh and Gimpel, this traditional family-run farmstead provides authentic alpine tranquility. Cozy guest rooms and holiday apartments decorated in solid wood furnishings feature private balconies overlooking the alpine scenery. A homemade breakfast featuring farm-fresh local products ensures an energetic start. Summer brings hiking, via ferratas, and swims in nearby Lake Haldensee, while winter visitors enjoy local ski slopes and panoramic cross-country ski trails.
kurzbeschreibung: Charming family farmstead and holiday apartments in Nesselwängle in the scenic Tannheim Valley.
